page.overview:
Who is Brother Martinus?

Brother Martinus is a young man, tall and strong. From beneath his tonsured hair, gentle, sympathetic eyes bring peace to everyone he meets. He always carries his prayer book and slingbag.

He is kindly and dedicated, persevering in the face of impossible odds. At night, when alone, the enormity of his task often overwhelms him till he weeps and drinks himself to sleep.

He is driven to fight to reclaim lost souls, and seeks to bring about the reform of prison life and the elimination of the death sentence.
